body:
The generated workflow adds `queue: max` to write-job concurrency blocks. GitHub Actions concurrency supports only `group` and `cancel-in-progress`, so actionlint v1.7.12 reports:

```text
unexpected key "queue" for "concurrency" section. expected one of "cancel-in-progress", "group"
```

Reproduction:

```bash
actionlint .github/workflows/*.yml
```

Please remove `queue: max` from all job concurrency sections and update tests/docs that require it. `cancel-in-progress: false` already preserves the running write; GitHub manages at most one pending run per concurrency group.
title: Remove unsupported queue key from workflow concurrency blocks
